note: activity bar -- platform's own navigation icons for explorer, search, source control, run, extensions, accounts, and settings
explorer viewlet chrome -- renders: view title, new file/folder/refresh/collapse all actions; the file tree contents are subtracted
viewlet title bar -- renders: view title and more actions dropdown
editor part -- renders: editor tabs, tab actions (close, split, more), and getting started page content
status bar -- renders: host, scm, problems, forwarded ports, notifications, and screen reader mode indicators
top menu bar -- platform's own interface controls for file, edit, selection, view, go, run, terminal, help
aria notifications -- platform's own system notifications
aria status -- platform's own status messages
notification toasts -- platform's own toast notifications and actions
